name: Valencia, Spain

visa.notes: Non-lucrative visa requires proof of sufficient funds (~€2,400/mo). Cannot work in Spain on this visa.

rent.notes: Brainsre Q3 2026 asking rents for Valencia city: 16.32 EUR/m2, average flat 1,593 EUR (+8.4% y/y), 2BR 1,574, 3BR 1,660. Pet-friendly stock is scarcer, so typical sits near the 2BR average; min reflects outer districts and metro-area towns, max central 3BR. Stored 1,050 was well below current asking.

sources.title: Alquiler piso Valencia - precios Q3 2026 (Brainsre)

groceries.notes: Valencia groceries 200-320 EUR per person (400-640 for two) in 2026, Mercadona/Consum pricing a bit under Malaga, plus roughly 60-90 EUR/mo of kibble for a 100 lb dog (modelled share). Spain headline CPI 4.9% y/y in Oct 2026.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Valencia 2026 (Freenance)
INE - IPC adelantado octubre 2026

utilities.notes: Valencia electricity+water+gas for a 70 m2 flat 90-160 EUR/mo (electricity alone 50-90); national 85 m2 basic utilities 133 EUR and a 2-person electricity bill 50-60 EUR. Includes butane/gas, water, sewer and the municipal trash fee; summer A/C and a larger 3BR push to the max. Internet excluded.

healthcare.notes: National pricing: non-EU resident retirees carry full no-copay private cover; Adeslas Plena Plus is 167 EUR/person/month at 60-64 (published table is Andalucia zone 2, Valencia zone pricing is similar but not separately published), with 61-70 quotes of 175-230 per person across insurers. Min is the convenio especial at 60 EUR/person under 65 after one year of residence (SIP card, no outpatient prescriptions). Re-modelled from old template.

insurance.notes: Renters/contents only; health cover moved to healthcare per the old-template rule. Tenant policies run 70-300 EUR/yr nationally (Tuio from 79, Caser from 110, Santalucia from 141 per year).

sources.title: Seguro para inquilinos: precios (Selectra, updated Jan 2025)

petCare.notes: Spain vet prices Apr 2026: consultation 30-60, annual vaccine pack 50-80, rabies 15-25, deworming 20-35/yr, dental 100-250; healthy pet 200-400 EUR/yr. Large-breed preventive doses and leishmania prevention lift a Bernese above the mid-point.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta el veterinario - precios abril 2026 (CuantoMeCuesta)

petDaycare.notes: National 2026 guide: residencia canina 11-25 EUR/night, guarderia 9-20 EUR/day; 4-6 nights or days a month at the large-dog end.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta un cuidador de perros - precios 2026 (Cronoshare)

petGrooming.notes: Large long-haired dog bath 30-35 EUR, full arreglo 40-45, giant 42-51, de-matting extra; every 6-8 weeks averages about 40 EUR/mo.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta un servicio de peluqueria canina - precios 2026 (Cronoshare)

transportation.notes: Valencia is flat and transit-rich: SUMA monthly 1-zone pass (metro, EMT bus, Cercanias) is 35 EUR, so two passes are 70 EUR; metro TuiN rides 0.80 capped at 35/mo. Typical adds a small car used part-time (insurance about 390 EUR/yr, gasolina 95 about 1.53 EUR/L, maintenance/ITV/tax); max is full car use plus parking. Senior fares start at 65.

sources.title: Precios de billetes y abonos transporte en Valencia 2026 (RedTransporte)
CHECK24 - prima media del seguro de coche mayo 2026
Precio del combustible hoy 3 de julio 2026 (El Cronista)

entertainment.notes: Fibre 25-40 EUR (300-600 Mbps bundles with mobile 30-48), streaming, dinner for two 40-65 EUR three times a month, menu del dia 11-16 pp, gym 20-35 pp, cinema 7-10. Slightly below Costa del Sol dining prices.

clothing.notes: National chain pricing (Levi's 501-type jeans about 90 EUR in Spanish cities per Expatistan, Feb 2026); a couple's replacement wardrobe near 80 EUR/mo. Stored range retained.

sources.title: Price of jeans in Malaga (Expatistan, Feb 2026)

personalCare.notes: Men's haircut about 18 EUR, toothpaste about 1.92, shampoo 2.50-4 (Oct 2026); two adults with monthly haircuts and toiletries near 60 EUR.

sources.title: Prices in Spain (WageCentre, updated 4 Oct 2026)

phoneCell.notes: Two mobile-only lines (Nov 2026): Lowi 10 EUR for 2x15GB, MasMovil 9.80, Digi 16 EUR unlimited on both lines, Finetwork 20. National pricing.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: Private GP 25-60 EUR, specialist 60-120, full blood panel 49-75 in Valencia (Doctoralia/Top Doctors 2025-2026). With no-copay private cover, OOP is mainly dental, physio, optics and self-pay extras.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta una consulta medica privada en Espana (Selectra)

healthcare.system: Valencian public health system (Conselleria de Sanitat) with modern hospitals. Private options plentiful.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 3-8 weeks for specialists. Private: under 2 weeks.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Public covers most prescriptions with co-pays based on income

pros: Excellent value for a major Mediterranean city
City of Arts and Sciences, great cultural scene
Good metro and bus system, bikeable
